caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing centrally on a flat rectangular base with rounded edges, surrounded on three sides by a decorative arch. The figure is wearing a long robe in shades of green and light blue, with a draped sash of a darker green crossing diagonally from the left shoulder to the right waist. The figure's right hand is raised to the chest and the left hand hangs at the side. There is an aura-like golden yellow halo with spiked edges around the head, and the figure's brown hair is partially covered with a red band or scarf. The arch that surrounds the figure consists of vertical columns on the left and right made up of alternating pinkish-red, tulip-shaped floral elements and green, rounded, segmented sections. The arch’s top is composed of two stylized green serpentine shapes facing inward, each with a red eye and red markings, touching in the middle above the figure's head. The overall composition is symmetrical, and the background is an unadorned light beige color.
title: Unpublished Print for Immaculate Conception
